package.name: nuxeo-agentic-records
package.title: Nuxeo Satori records: disposition review, physical records and legal holds

description.p: The records module's server add-on, on the platform's retention module. A disposition run holds the records whose retention has ended and that are under no legal hold; two people other than its starter approve it, and only then are the records deleted, or a physical record's destruction or transfer recorded, with a certificate kept as a record. Physical records have a barcode, a location and a chain of custody the server records. A record under a legal hold is kept beyond the platform's own guard: it is not put in the trash nor deleted, an administrator's request included, nor is a folder holding one, and its files are not changed, each refused on the server with a reason. One operation, Records.ReleaseLegalHold, releases a hold with a reason the platform audits, as the person and with their ManageLegalHold, for an operation button the deployment's allow-list names. Everything is checked on the server, and nothing is disposed of until a run has its two approvals.
